sam (sre): Quick note: we're tightening an internal SLO window for model-serving tail latency from 30m->15m starting next Monday 00:00 UTC. This only affects internal alerts; no customer SLAs change.

nina (oncall): why the change? any expected pages increase?

sam (sre): We saw recurring P99 spikes concentrated in short bursts that were masked by the 30m window. Shortening to 15m helps detect regressions faster. Expect a small bump in noisy pages for the first week; we'll enable a suppression rule for known noise sources.

kai (platform): will console show the SLO change? need to update runbooks and dashboards.

sam (sre): console will show an internal note. @kai please update the runbook and add a dashboard card that highlights 1m/5m/15m P99. Ops-bot will create a task.

ops-bot: Task created: "Update runbooks + dashboards for 15m SLO window" assigned to kai.

nina (oncall): I'll monitor during the first 72h. If >30% more pages, we'll revert and investigate root causes.

sam (sre): thanks. Reminder: this is detection tuning only. No customer-facing change. Closing thread unless issues pop up.
